summary: This note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on SM UB-17, a German Type UB I submarine (U-boat) of the Imperial German Navy during World War I. The note states that the submarine disappeared during a patrol in March 1918.
one_line: SM UB-17 was a German Type UB I U-boat of the Imperial German Navy in World War I that vanished on patrol in March 1918.
key_facts: SM UB-17 was a German Type UB I submarine, also called a U-boat.
SM UB-17 served in the German Imperial Navy during World War I.
SM UB-17 disappeared during a patrol in March 1918.
